The '''Five World Deputy Prime Minister''' served as the Deputy to the [[Five World Prime Minister]]. [[Denjax Teppler]] held the position in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] and became the acting Prime Minister when [[Aidel Saxan]], the Prime Minister, was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]].

==Behind the scenes==
The position is mentioned in [[2006]]'s ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'' when Teppler is referred to as "Saxan's Deputy."
